QuestInfo.name: [Icy Onslaught - Town Defense] Activate the Barrier Generator
QuestInfo.0: Claudine asks you to to help defend Edelstein from the invading Frost Fiends.\r\nShe asks you to gather fuel for the Barrier Generator during town defense, and activate the generator.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine asks you to to help defend Edelstein from the invading Frost Fiends.\r\nYou must gather fuel to power the Barrier Generator during town defense. Click on the Barrier Generator and read the manual to learn how to start it.\r\nYou can only play the Barrier Generator mini-game once per wave of the invasion. However, at least #r30 players per world must succeed in activating the generator#k in order to succeed in town defense.
